item.text:
Hi [Coordinator’s Name],

I’m looking forward to volunteering during the exhibition weekend. With the larger crowds expected, would it be possible to assign me to a quieter role or area? I’d be happy to help prepare materials, organize supplies, or assist with other behind-the-scenes tasks. I still want to contribute wherever I can be useful, but a less crowded setting would help me do my best work.

Thank you for considering my request and for coordinating everything!

Best,
[Your Name]
